name: J.S.
message: Newport Company:  No response  It has come to my attention the grave danger that smoking cigarettes projects. I understand that you want to make money and I respect that, however I cannot respect how you go about doing it. It isn’t much different than a drug dealer on the streets selling dope to good, honest people.  I hope that deep down in your cancerous tobacco caked hearts you realize the immoral problem I have with this! But you do it anyway to make money. Money, that’s all there is in life to you. Who has more toys. Every toy you have is a life lost to tobacco induced cancer. There are honest ways to make money, and although it may not be as much, it is good, honest money. Please consider this for the sake of your fellow Americans. These are your children, your grandchildren, that will be born of birth defects from an addiction you have supplied.
